verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an API platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence only shows static docs describing OpenAI-compatible endpoints and parameters, with nothing about an interactive explorer or runnable in-browser examples. Probes for an OpenAPI or Swagger spec all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
